primitives.name: Compile-Time Kernel Configuration
primitives.verbatim_quote: cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20) project(gsi_embedded_braid_kernel VERSION 5.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20) set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON) set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF) if(MSVC) add_compile_options(/W4 /O2 /GR- /EHs-c-) else() add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -O3 -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -ffast-math) endif() add_library(gsi_embedded_braid_kernel STATIC gsi_embedded_braid_kernel.cpp gsi_cte_viscoelastic_waveguide_kernel.cpp ) target_include_directories(gsi_embedded_braid_kernel PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}) enable_testing() add_executable(embedded_kernel_tests tests/embedded_kernel_tests.cpp ) target_link_libraries(embedded_kernel_tests PRIVATE gsi_embedded_braid_kernel) add_test(NAME EmbeddedKernelTests COMMAND embedded_kernel_tests)
